title: Mastering Google Ads for Florists: What You Need to Know - Calabasas Blooms

facts.fact: Google Ads operates on a pay-per-click (PPC) model, so an advertiser pays only when someone clicks the ad, according to the vendor page.
facts.quote: Google Ads operates on a pay-per-click (PPC) model, meaning you only pay when someone clicks on your ad.

facts.fact: The page lists four Google Ads campaign types for florists: Search, Display, Shopping, and Video ads.
facts.quote: Search Ads: Appear on search results when potential customers look for floral services.

facts.fact: The page describes Manual CPC bidding as the option where the advertiser controls the maximum cost-per-click for ads.
facts.quote: You control the maximum cost-per-click for your ads.

facts.fact: The page describes Enhanced CPC as a bidding option where Google optimizes bids based on the likelihood of a conversion.
facts.quote: Google optimizes your bids based on the likelihood of a conversion.

facts.fact: The page describes Target CPA as a bidding option where the advertiser sets a specific cost per acquisition and Google adjusts bids automatically.
facts.quote: Set a specific cost per acquisition for your ads, and Google will automatically adjust your bids.
